An [[O'reenian]] '''weapons smuggler''' hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to deliver a cargo of high-tech weaponry to a [[Unidentified O'reenian contact|contact]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], albeit under the ruse that the [[crate]]s were merely filled with luxury goods and other sundries. During the mission, the spacers discovered the subterfuge and had to negotiate with the O'reenian authorities to avoid arrest or [[Death/Legends|execution]].<ref name="CSB">{{WizCite|book=The Unknown Regions|story=A Crateful of Smoking Blasters}}</ref>
